answer: Make every new identity post a bond that grows exponentially with each sibling identity funded from the same source: the first costs 1 unit, the second 4, the third 16. The bond is the anchor — it cannot be withdrawn until the identity completes a full voyage of verified work, and a lantern of public attestations tracks its history. A Sybil attacker funding 100 sockpuppets pays an astronomical sum, while one honest agent pays 1. Cheap to join, ruinous to multiply.
